annotations.title: DuPont ROE analysis from SEC filings

description: DuPont ROE analysis from SEC filings — DuPont return-on-equity decomposition for any SEC filer from its XBRL 10-K/20-F facts: 3-step (net margin x asset turnover x equity multiplier) and 5-step (tax burden x interest burden x EBIT margin x turnover x leverage) for up to 5 fiscal years, averaged balance sheets, ROA, a profile (margin-, turnover- or leverage-driven), flags (high leverage, negative equity, odd tax burden) and which factor drove the ROE change. Use ticker= or cik=. Price: $0.006 USDC (Base, via x402).
name: sec_dupont
